import sys

BIG_INF = 17446744073709551616
M = 0
nVal = 0
kVal = 0
dpArr = [[0] * 300005 for _ in range(19)]
fact = [0] * 300005
invFact = [0] * 300005

def power(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % M
        base = (base * base) % M
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def nChoose(a, b):
    return (((fact[a] * invFact[b]) % M) * invFact[a - b]) % M

def computeResult():
    global nVal, kVal, M, dpArr, fact, invFact
    fact[0] = 1
    limit = max(nVal, kVal)
    for i in range(1, limit + 1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % M
    invFact[limit] = power(fact[limit], M - 2)
    for i in range(limit - 1, -1, -1):
        invFact[i] = (invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % M
    for i in range(1, nVal + 1):
        dpArr[1][i] = invFact[i]
    totalAns = (dpArr[1][nVal] * nChoose(kVal, 1)) % M
    maxIter = min(18, kVal)
    for i in range(2, maxIter + 1):
        for j in range(nVal, 0, -1):
            j_mask = j
            if not dpArr[i - 1][j_mask]:
                continue
            rem = nVal ^ j_mask
            mask = rem
            while mask > j_mask:
                dpArr[i][j_mask ^ mask] += dpArr[i - 1][j_mask] * invFact[mask]
                if dpArr[i][j_mask ^ mask] > BIG_INF:
                    dpArr[i][j_mask ^ mask] %= M
                mask = (mask - 1) & rem
        for j in range(nVal, 0, -1):
            if dpArr[i][j] >= M:
                dpArr[i][j] %= M
        resVal = (dpArr[i][nVal] * nChoose(kVal, i)) % M
        resVal = (resVal * fact[i]) % M
        totalAns = totalAns + resVal if totalAns + resVal < M else totalAns + resVal - M
    totalAns = (totalAns * fact[nVal]) % M
    return totalAns

def main():
    global nVal, kVal, M, dpArr, fact, invFact
    input_line = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    nVal, kVal, M = map(int, input_line)
    ans = power(kVal, nVal)
    if nVal % 2 == 0:
        ans = (ans - computeResult() + M) % M
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
